parts.gloss: they who do not (negative personal suffix)

words.gloss: those who do not love (strangers or enemies)

parts.gloss: suffix indicating passive or future state

literal: Those who do not love, to love they will be subjected, those who from proper behavior towards old friends do not deviate.
translation: Those who never deviate from proper courtesy towards long-standing friends will be loved and cherished even by those who do not love them.
modern: பழைய நண்பர்களிடம் காட்டும் அன்பான பண்பிலிருந்து விலகாமல் நடப்பவர்களை, அவர்களை விரும்பாத பகைவர்களும் விரும்பும் நிலை ஏற்படும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the power of maintaining long-standing relationships with courtesy and loyalty. The poet states that those who do not deviate from the proper code of conduct towards their old friends earn universal respect. Their steadfastness is so admirable that even strangers or enemies who previously did not care for them will come to love and desire their friendship. The key lies in preserving the intimacy of old friendships without overstepping boundaries or losing respect.
